headline: Embry-Riddle stretch unbeaten start with fifth win
dek: Embry-Riddle beat SCAD at home for a fifth win, the draw at Spring Hill the only point they have dropped. They have conceded six goals in all, and no side has beaten them at home or away.
displaced_by: Embry-Riddle's win over SCAD: the standing dek's four wins and a draw is no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, though Barry's win at Florida Memorial has narrowed the margin.

wire.line: Florida Southern's first defeat leaves Embry-Riddle and Lynn as the only unbeaten sides.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result: Palm Beach Atlantic's against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's against Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Tech have conceded five goals across three wins, two draws and a defeat, and neither Mars Hill nor Nova Southeastern could score against them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins have lost two in a row, at home to Embry-Riddle and then at Tampa, and their twelve goals conceded are more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn are still unbeaten and have drawn three in a row away from home since beating Mississippi College in their opener.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ricardo Marques has kept three clean sheets for Florida Southern and has conceded five goals in all.

last_match.line: Embry-Riddle have not lost this season; the only points they have dropped came at Spring Hill.

next_match.line: Saint Leo have won every match at home; Tampa arrive on back-to-back wins without conceding.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
